decision: No additional persistent upper lines passed the declared support rule. Preserve all13 old OSC parameters. Test source-fitted fine spectral resonators and, separately, slow correlated amplitude statistics; do not synthesize the unsupported peak inventories.
filter_method: Training-only 0.5s periodic-Hann Welch PSD,8Hz Gaussian smoothing, raised-cosine band edges, real-cepstrum minimum phase then8192tap truncation. Kernels contain spectral-shape parameters, not original waveform/time trajectories. Unit stationary variance, nonnegative power-debt fit over the same physical bands. No seed-specific gain.
envelope_method: 200ms native Hann band-power measurements every20ms from training only. Center half-log-power; fit full cross-band covariance and one trace-weighted lag1 correlation, bounded0..0.98. Generate new stationary Gaussian vector states, cosine-interpolate at50Hz and exponentiate at fixed strength0.5. Subtract strength^2 times exact interpolated variance to preserve expected squared gain. Apply only to detail streams, never to OSC phases or frequencies. Measured full-band energy variations are a proxy, not separated physical mechanical envelopes.
comparison: Frozen original versus finer stationary resonators versus finer resonators plus fresh amplitude variation. Include unfit F2 holdout reference. Shared gain, no room, no individual loudness normalization; all three seeds retained. Finer-static isolates spectrum from modulation. Inspect grain/hiss, beating, pumping and missing HF. No claim of perceptual improvement before listening.
controls: Before real fitting: known minimum-phase response and convolution/variance identities; analytic two-band envelope power; generated-state recurrence and interpolated variance identity. Audit independently using saved profile/direct convolution, DFT/Parseval and scalar state recurrence. Keep original shared-phase and actual RPM/load qualification separate.
runtime: Isolated Python study. No C/runtime/profile/default/UI replacement; FIR rendering cost is not a real-time qualification. Holdout is used only for final reported observations, never model selection.
